policySelection.metric: Development mean actual continuous contact; reject increases in return failure; tie break extra HOLD then route length. Freeze chosen weight before holdout.
policySelection.fallback: If no policy beats the matched endpoint reference, retain endpoint reference and report failure.

limitations: All 72 placements and virtual position/radius fixes are synthetic, not independent actual observations. Source diameter and drift priors come from observations.
Raw MEDA weather is not used as a 2D position sensor.
1 m spacing is not rock-scale traversability or registration accuracy. Missing/steep support is blocked.
Same actual remaining budgets, delay, observations, execution and terrain apply to all non-oracle arms.
Free-plane geometry omits resources and terrain and is a separate reference, not pooled with DEM performance.
Navcam is local north/east; orbital DEM is east/south. They are never overlaid without registration.
No guarantee, physical injury rate, CFD or calibrated probability is claimed.

amendment.reason: Counterbalance family × terrain × source in all 54 holdout cases; initial indexing accidentally confounded bearing with terrain. Preserve original protocol.

changes: Carry remaining edge time into all planners; avoids repeated backward/forward 2 s connector loop confirmed on development dev-006.
Base is not a shelter. Simulate through a fixed per-case encounter window even after early return.
54 fresh counterbalanced placements plus 45 controlled distance-ladder cases; all paired arms share identical inputs.
